description: Passenger counts for an SBB station from the data.sbb.ch frequency dataset. Returns average daily, weekday, and weekend boardings and alightings (Ein- und Aussteigende). Newest year first.

contains.description: When true, match station names that contain the text. Default false matches the whole name.

station.description: Station name as published by SBB (e.g. Bern, Zürich HB, Genève).

year.description: Optional year (e.g. 2024). Omit to return the newest years.

name: get_station_passengers
